rules: Official guidance says GIS can store or edit downloaded GML and compare or integrate it with other datasets.
A publication contains data from the preceding month rather than the publication month itself.
The current monthly data remains accessible until the following publication replaces it.
Official guidance identifies QGIS as a free open-source tool able to view GML and convert it to other formats.
The guidance gives KML conversion as the example workflow for use in Google Maps.
Using GML in another tool may require both format conversion and a projection suitable for the target system.
Exact current Barnet and Enfield download hrefs, response bytes and SHA-256 values remain unavailable.
Current INSPIRE polygon IDs and native-BNG containment for all three candidates remain unresolved.
Planning Data publishes an OpenAPI definition for its API.
The official documentation says the OpenAPI file can be used to generate a client library.
The entity search endpoint supports JSON, HTML and GeoJSON response formats.
A separate endpoint returns one entity by its numeric entity identifier.
The dataset-list endpoint supports JSON and HTML formats.
A dataset can be retrieved by its dataset slug through the documented dataset endpoint.
The q parameter is documented for postcode or UPRN search, not title-boundary reference search.
The period filter controls whether current-only or all entries are returned.
Entry-date year, month and day filters support match, before and since semantics.
The API supports equals, disjoint, touches, covers, coveredby, overlaps and crosses in addition to within, intersects and contains.
Fields explicitly selected by field take precedence over exclude_field.
Exact current responses for references 52040420, 52213916 and 52213412 remain unavailable.
Exact title-boundary intersection responses for the three candidate coordinates remain unavailable.
Authoritative UPRNs bound to the three candidates remain unavailable.
The 1m composite DTM covers approximately 99 percent of England.
The DTM is produced from the last or only laser pulse returned to the sensor.
Surface objects are removed using bespoke algorithms and manual editing.
Where repeat surveys exist, the newest best-resolution data is selected.
Resampled source data is bilinearly interpolated before merging.
The 2022 composite records source surveys from 6 June 2000 through 2 April 2022.
Metadata index catalogues identify which survey was used at a location.
The composite is distributed as GeoTIFF rasters in 5km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid.
Heights are metres to Ordnance Datum Newlyn with OSTN15 transformation.
The dataset metadata records annual update frequency.
The composite is licensed under the Open Government Licence.
The metadata states there are no public access constraints, subject to the stated licence.
The metadata publishes an England-scale latitude and longitude extent for coverage validation.
The dataset has a stable metadata identifier 13787b9a-26a4-4775-8523-806d13af58fc.
The projection guidance says surveys after 26 August 2016 use the OSGM15 geoid model.
A 1m DSM may average at least one point per square metre, but the DTM under vegetation may not.
The portal supplies 5km tiles and does not provide a whole-country bulk download through the normal interface.
DSP API clients must negotiate TLS 1.2 or TLS 1.3 after legacy TLS removal.
The exact GetCapabilities XML and DTM coverage identifier remain unread in this runtime.
Exact TQ2892 pixels and their source-survey lineage records remain unavailable.
OS Terrain 50 is updated annually in July.
The product documentation records a nominal scale of 1:50,000.
Access to the OpenData product is free through the OS Data Hub.
The product is free to view, download and use for commercial, educational and personal purposes.
OS recommends discovering current API content because products may be changed, added or removed.
The Downloads API does not provide previous releases of OpenData products.
OpenData downloads can be filtered by fileName, format, subformat and area.
A request that matches no known content returns a documented 404 response.
GeoPackage and vector-tile supplies are provided as one national flat file rather than tiled folders.
Tiled data is ZIP-compressed and not encrypted.
Minimum coverage extends to low water; most heights use Newlyn Datum while a small number of offshore islands use local datum.
The exact live Terrain50 area=TQ API response remains unavailable.
The current TQ29 archive bytes, nested file list and hashes remain unavailable.
The actual Terrain 50 cells for the three candidate points remain unavailable.

promotion.reason: Exact current HMLR GML/native-BNG containment, Planning candidate responses/references/UPRNs, EA TQ2892 WCS coverage/pixels/source survey, OS TQ29 archive/cells and shared F-host revision14 receipts remain absent.

runtime_transport.failure: Web retrieval returned redirect-loop, safe-URL or unsupported-content errors; the previously diagnosed execution-runtime DNS blocker remains unresolved.
